{{Quote|They have me shackled so I cannot escape. I think Vinros has the key, and there is the underboss outside and lots of henchman.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Donovan (captain)|Donovan]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WHtD" />}}
'''Vinros''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Deflarians|Deflarian]] henchman who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:WHtD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the Deflarians hijacked a ship piloted by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Donovan (captain)|Donovan]] of the [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] in order to stole its cargo of weapons. They also captured Donovan and imprisoned him in the [[Deflarian bunker]]. CorSec [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] [[Cora (Human)|Cora]] therefore hired a spacer to investigate the situation. The spacer managed to find the location of the bunker, infiltrated the building and found the imprisoned Captain Donovan. The spacer eventually killed Vinros, several Deflarian henchmen and a Deflarian underboss to liberate Donovan.<ref name="SWG:WHtD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vinros was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WHtD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vinros was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
